scripts.test:renderer: pnpm --dir ../frontend build && pnpm build && electron scripts/check-production-renderer.mjs
scripts.test:renderer:ci: pnpm --dir ../frontend build && pnpm build && electron --no-sandbox scripts/check-production-renderer.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently --kill-others --success first -n vite,electron "pnpm --dir ../frontend dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ANYDATAS_ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron ."
